# Developing Potential UK

> > Developing Potential UK delivers MBTI workshops, personality assessments, and team building programmes across London and the UK, specializing in leadership development and organizational talent assessment.

Developing Potential UK is a leading provider of personality-based training and team development services, offering certified MBTI facilitation, psychometric assessments (16pf, EQ-i, Hogan, FIRO-B), and experiential team building programmes. The organization serves professionals, leaders, organizations, and educational institutions across the UK and internationally.

## Key Topics

- MBTI (Myers Briggs Type Indicator)
- Personality Assessment
- Team Building
- Leadership Development
- Emotional Intelligence (EQ-i)
- FIRO-B
- 16pf
- Hogan Personality Inventory
- Team Management Profile
- Talent Assessment
- Executive Coaching
- Team Development
- Psychometric Testing
- London & Manchester
- Organizational Development

## Core Personality Assessments

- [Online Personality Tests for individuals and organisations](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests): Main personality tests page covering MBTI, 16pf, EQ-i, Hogan and other assessments
- [MBTI Personality Test London. MBTI Trainer Coach Facilitator](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests/myers-briggs-type-indicator-trainer-london): MBTI training and team building workshops delivered by London-based practitioners
- [Myers Briggs MBTI Step 2 Test London, UK & International Delivery](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests/myers-briggs-type-indicator-mbti-step-2-trainer-london): MBTI Step 2 advanced assessment for team building and executive coaching
- [16pf Personality Test Trainer London](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests/16pf-personality-assessment): 16pf personality assessment for coaching, selection and leadership development
- [EQ-i 2.0 Personality Test. Emotional Intelligence EQI Test. Qualified Coach](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests/eqi-test-emotional-quotient-inventory): EQ-i 2.0 and EQ360 emotional intelligence assessments for coaching and development
- [Hogan Personality Test: HPI, MVPI & HDS](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests/hogan-personality-test): Hogan personality assessments including HPI, HDS and MVPI for talent development
- [FIRO-B Personality Test. FIRO B Trainer & Facilitator London.](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/firo-b-personality-test-london): FIRO-B personality test for team and leadership development with global delivery
- [Team Management Profile Trainer Facilitator London Manchester](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests/margerison-mccann-team-management-profile): Team Management Profile workshops for team building and development UK-wide
- [Take the MTQ48 Test Online.](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests/mtq48): MTQ48 mental toughness assessment for resilience and performance development

## Professional & Recruitment Assessments

- [Personality Tests for Professionals, Leaders & Teams](https://www.developing-potential.co.uk/personality-tests/online-personality-tests-assessments): Personality tests and assessments for professionals including MBTI, 16pf, Hogan
